Hi Alex / Priya — thanks for the clear asks. See answers below and attached docs.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf; Redwood_Vuln_Management_Process.pdf; Redwood_PenTest_Executive_Summary_redacted.pdf

Answers: 
- SOC 2: We completed a SOC 2 Type II in Q4 2025. I attached a short summary that highlights the scope (production inference runtime, control domains) and the audit firm. We can share the full report under an NDA — happy to coordinate if needed.
- GDPR/HIPAA / BAA: Redwood supports BAA for customers with HIPAA obligations. We have a standard BAA and can start the process; for GDPR we have data processing addenda and region controls. If FinHealth needs a BAA, I can loop in legal to start.
- Pen test: Redwood performs an annual third-party penetration test and running cadence of monthly automated external scans + quarterly internal scans. The attached executive summary is redacted (removes test artifacts and IP) — Rishi will handle secure delivery of any additional redaction requests. We typically provide an exec summary publicly and share the full report under a strict NDA and SFTP transfer.
- Vulnerability management SLA: Our standard SLA is: Critical: 72 hours to remediation or a documented mitigations/compensating controls plan; High: 14 days; Medium: 30 days; Low: 90 days. We also track time-to-remediate and publish an internal monthly dashboard.
- Bug bounty / disclosure: We do not currently run a public bug bounty, but we maintain a coordinated disclosure program and tred a private researcher program via our vendor partners (we can share contact info on request).

Next steps I will take today:
- Rishi will send a secure portal invite (DocuSign/vendor portal) to security@finhealth.com for the vendor questionnaire.
- Ben will coordinate secure SFTP/portal access for the redacted pen test exec summary if you want the file transferred directly.
- I'll loop in Legal for BAA if you confirm that's required.

Would you like a 30-min run-through with Ben next week to walk through the vuln mgmt process and evidence?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
